title: Flour from the Mill

readiness.math: sorting by kind; comparing weight: heavier, lighter, the same; big and small scoops (2 and 1)
readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: Welcome to the mill! The river turns the big wheel, and the wheel turns the heavy stones that make flour.

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: But first, the grain must be clean. The light, papery bits are called chaff. They don't belong in our bread.

older.prompt: Sort everything: grain in the sack, chaff in the basket, and little stones in the pot.
older.hint: Grain is round and golden. Chaff is light and flat. Stones are grey and hard.

steps.speaker: tobias
steps.prompt: Put the grain in the sack, and the chaff in the basket.
steps.hint: Grain is round and golden. Chaff is light and flat.

feedback.mismatch: Look closely. Is that grain, or chaff?
feedback.all_good: All sorted! Clean grain, ready for the millstones.

older.hint: Count the dots on the stone, and the dots on the scoops. Can you make them the same?

steps.speaker: tobias
steps.prompt: Now the grain is flour! I need a bag as heavy as my stone. Would you please add scoops of flour until the beam is level?
steps.hint: Watch the beam. If the stone side is lower, add a scoop. If the flour side is lower, take one out. A little scoop helps you get it just right.

feedback.heavy: Now the flour side is lower. It's too heavy. Take one scoop out.
feedback.all_good: The beam is level! The flour weighs the same as the stone.

outro.speaker: tobias
outro.text: Just right! Thank you. Tomorrow, this flour will become bread. Will you come and bake it with me?

older.journal_line: I helped at the mill. I sorted grain, chaff and stones, and balanced the flour against a stone with seven dots.

journal_line: I helped at the mill. I sorted the grain from the chaff, and weighed the flour until the scale was level.
unavailable_text: The flour is ready for Mr. Tobias. The millstones are resting.
